topic: Proof for non-GitHub or remoteless checkouts under a public root
detail: A checkout whose remote is not on GitHub (GitLab, local-only) has no remote fact, so under a public root the root rule places it public. Decide whether such content needs proof before SP-023 writers use the classifier.
note: Settled by the user on 2026-11-10: quarantine without proof; see D-50.
